ios.intro: Enable the Safari extension to hide selected distractions on instagram.com.
steps: Enable “No Reel For Instagram” and allow it on the sites you browse.
Open instagram.com and reload to apply your preferences.

mac.stateOn: No Reel For Instagram is active. Choose what to hide from its Safari toolbar button.
mac.stateOff: No Reel For Instagram is off. Enable it in Safari Settings > Extensions.
mac.stateUnknown: Turn on No Reel For Instagram in Safari Settings > Extensions.
steps: Check “No Reel For Instagram” and grant it access to instagram.com.
Refresh instagram.com to apply your toolbar preferences.
